Pending bills

Live bills in the states whose sessions are still open: Massachusetts (the 194th General Court runs through January 2027) and the DC Council (Council Period 26 runs through 2026). In every other state the session is over, so a bill that did not pass has died.

Bills are sorted by most recent action. “Days idle” counts back from 2026-10-18; a last action dated later than that is a scheduled step. A long idle spell in a committee usually means a bill is stalled, but Massachusetts bills can be revived. Ceremonial measures are left out.

Cross-state view of 6 states’ 2025–26 sessions. Topics and directions are labelled by an AI model from each bill’s title and official summary, and are approximate. Sessions differ in length and in how bills die, so compare with care.
